title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust sets a universal standard, ensuring AI navigation systems are trustworthy across all environments and use cases.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential—it exposes flaws, drives innovation, and ensures NavTrust doesn’t become a closed, unverified protocol.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust includes real-world datasets and evaluation metrics, like safety and compliance, that benchmarking alone can’t enforce.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Without benchmarking, NavTrust is just a theory—how do you measure trustworthiness if you don’t compare against known performance baselines?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Benchmarking makes NavTrust credible—without it, we’re just talking about ideals, not progress.
